purpose: which render.py produced the committed figures and video, and the evidence that a later source reproduces them

render_py.role: lint-only refactor (statements split, lambdas to def, imports separated, one variable renamed); no logic change

reproduction_check.method: rendered the committed result files with each render.py into a temp copy under TasksMax=128 MemoryMax=3G MemorySwapMax=0 and compared sha256

o2_source_py.check: reran the refactored o2_source.py on the same model and stored results; the output JSON is byte-identical
